soil.preparation: Add compost or well-rotted manure before planting
Incorporate organic matter to improve fertility
Work in compost and possibly form raised beds for drainage
Mix in compost, clear stones, level the bed
Test pH; add lime if needed, then compost

requirements.water: High early, mulch to retain moisture
Keep moist until established, then moderately regular
Regular watering, consistent but not waterlogged

feeding.schedule: Low-nitrogen fertiliser at planting and at hilling (for tubers)
Nitrogen-rich side dressing 4–6 weeks after sowing/transplanting
High potassium fertiliser every 3–4 weeks during fruiting
Brassicas: apply nitrogen feed after transplanting and again when heads begin forming
Use balanced organic feed monthly; more potassium mid-season for roots

staking.notes: Use trellis or stake; tie stems as plant grows to support fruit
Use strong stakes early; tie loosely every 20–30 cm as plant grows
